invariants: only the current approved and enabled definition revision may be accepted or leased
live execution requires a stable Idempotency-Key, the current definition version, an explicit reason and a real alert identity
one tenant/playbook definition row serializes run-budget and cooldown admission so concurrent requests cannot overrun the approved policy
acceptance, independent approval, provider execution, cancellation and independent compensation are separate states
the original requester cannot approve or reject its execution and cannot approve compensation
provider calls execute outside the PostgreSQL transaction under a recoverable lease and use execution_id plus phase as the stable idempotency identity
HTTP success without exactly one durable provider receipt for every approved step never proves an external effect
a failed provider result that reports an external effect is classified partial instead of failed
compensation is available only for a completed or partial execution whose immutable receipt proves an external effect
request, approval and control transitions atomically commit workflow state, minimum audit and outbox
terminal step receipts, aggregate receipt, execution state, audit and outbox commit in one serializable PostgreSQL transaction
missing provider configuration remains approved_awaiting_executor with executor_status not_configured and is never displayed as success
legacy drill rows and response fields remain readable and never acquire a live external-effect identity
domain.compensation: execute only the reverse steps corresponding to immutable execution receipts with external_effect=true and retain both receipt chains

data.projection_identity: event_id is the immutable inbox identity; tenant_id + execution_id + aggregate_version is the aggregate ordering identity; provider receipts are tenant_id + provider + provider_receipt_id + phase

negative_tests: cross-tenant execution reads return not found
unapproved, disabled or stale definition revision cannot execute
missing alert identity or unstable idempotency is rejected
requester self-approval and self-compensation are rejected
stale workflow revision and changed idempotency payload are rejected
run-budget and cooldown conflicts create no execution side effect
provider success without durable step identities is rejected
compensation without a proven external effect is rejected

journeys: provider execution and immutable step receipts
provider timeout, lease recovery and retry exhaustion
partial external effect and independent compensation
stop_conditions: execution lease heartbeat or queue age budget breach
audit, outbox or workflow revision divergence

tests: G0 route, OpenAPI, generated client and action catalog
G1 lifecycle, tenant, approval, run-budget, receipt and compensation component tests
G2 sentinel PostgreSQL plus an approved real provider sandbox
G3 execution event, audit, provider and Kafka projection reconciliation
G4 execution concurrency, timeout and retry profile
G5 Windows Chrome request, approve, refresh, terminal receipt and compensate journey
G6 canary, in-flight rollback and observation
evidence: one trace binds definition version, request, approval, execution, every provider step receipt, compensation, audit and outbox
browser accepted/running/partial/failed/compensated states match the authoritative PostgreSQL workflow revision
Kafka acknowledgement occurs before the outbox row is marked published and terminal consumers reconcile by event_id and aggregate_version

playbook execution event topic and ACL exist
outbox publisher and downstream idempotent consumer are ready
current alert-service and Web UI images are bound to one immutable candidate manifest
